concerns.text: FR-002 requires collecting independent human ratings verified via Prolific ID. T015b is the only task addressing this, but it is marked as failed/unverifiable in the analyze report due to missing `real_ratings.csv` and incomplete ingestion logic. Without a working task to satisfy FR-002, the core requirement for real human data cannot be met.

Constitution Principle VI mandates consent records in `data/consent/`. T015c is the only task for this, but it is blocked by T015b (missing `real_ratings.csv`) and lacks the `--mode real` enforcement. This creates a deadlock where the consent requirement cannot be satisfied for the production path.

SC-005 requires measuring pipeline execution time against a 6-hour limit. T037 is the only task for this benchmark, but it is failed because `data/processed/power_analysis_results.json` (from T009) and `code/run_pipeline.py` (from T037a) are missing. The feasibility criterion is unmeasurable.

SC-001 and SC-003 require verifying LMM results and Tukey corrections. T019 is the only integration test for the full LMM pipeline, but it is failed because the artifact `tests/integration/test_lmm_pipeline.py` is missing. There is no automated evidence that the statistical pipeline produces required p-values.

SC-004 requires detecting straight-lining participants. T011a (contract test for rating schema) is failed and truncated, and T016 (cleaning logic) depends on it. Without a valid rating schema test and underlying data file, the verification of data quality exclusion criteria is incomplete.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and FR-006 require an audit trail. T008 (logging infrastructure) is failed because the verification step (creating `data/pipeline.log`) was not executed. The audit trail for exclusions is not established.

FR-002 assumes a sample size determined by power analysis. T009 is marked with 'UNRESOLVED-CLAIM' and T037 (benchmark) cannot run without its output. This creates a circular dependency where the target N is undefined, preventing T015b (real data collection) from proceeding.

T015a-Stub is tagged as [Unit Test Only] but references 'Prolific API stubbing' which is not a standard library feature. The task description implies a mock implementation that may not align with the actual Prolific API structure required by T015a-Real, potentially causing integration issues.
